description: This file defines the Translator interface for on-device translation, allowing for pluggable translation implementations. It is intended to be implemented by classes providing translation functionality.

classes.name: Translator
classes.description: An interface for translation components, specifying a suspend function for translating text from a source language to a destination language.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: A suspend function that takes input text, source language code, and destination language code, returning the translated text.
